shortDescription: 3M Gulf Ltd serves as the regional hub for 3M's diversified technology, manufacturing, and industrial operations in the UAE and Middle East.
whatTheyDo: 3M Gulf distributes and supports a wide portfolio of science-based products across safety and industrial, transportation and electronics, and consumer markets. Its Dubai operations provide application engineering, technical sales, and customer support for infrastructure and industrial clients across the GCC.
address: 3rd Floor, Building 20 (Baitek Building), Dubai Internet City, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Dubai Chamber of Commerce Directory - 3M Gulf Ltd

notes: Directory listed area as Downtown, but official UAE operational entity 3M Gulf Ltd is based in Building 20 (Baitek Building), Dubai Internet City.

shortDescription: 7X is the UAE's state-owned investment and holding group for trade, transport, and logistics, overseeing Emirates Post and related digital services.
whatTheyDo: 7X manages postal, express courier, and logistics services across the United Arab Emirates through operating entities including Emirates Post, EMX, and FINTX. It drives digital transformation in document management, parcel delivery, and supply chain solutions connecting the seven emirates globally.
address: Street 54, Marrakech Street, Al Garhoud, Dubai, UAE
notes: Directory listed area as Business Bay, but corporate headquarters of 7X (formerly Emirates Post Group) is located in Al Garhoud on Street 54 / Marrakech Street, Dubai; Business Bay only hosts a parcel locker automat at Executive Towers.

shortDescription: Aal Mir Trading Co. L.L.C is an established UAE-based distributor, logistics operator, and marketer of confectionery and FMCG brands.
whatTheyDo: Established in 1980, Aal Mir Trading Co. L.L.C distributes international confectionery and fast-moving consumer goods brands across supermarkets, groceries, and retail stores in the UAE and Oman. The company manages warehousing, brand marketing, and supply chain logistics from its hub in Dubai Investment Park.
address: Plot 598/932, Community 598, Street 78, Dubai Investment Park 1, Jebel Ali, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: ProTenders - Aal Mir Trading Co LLC Profile
Naukrigulf - Aal Mir Trading Co Profile

notes: Directory listed area as JLT, but Aal Mir Trading Co. L.L.C head office and central logistics facilities are located in Dubai Investment Park 1 (DIP), Jebel Ali.

shortDescription: ABB Industries LLC is the UAE operating entity of the global technology leader in electrification and automation.
whatTheyDo: ABB provides electrification, motion, industrial automation, and robotics products and solutions across the UAE and Middle East. Its Dubai facility in Al Quoz supports engineering, sales, and service operations for energy and industrial clients.
address: Street No. 4, Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: ATN Info UAE Business Directory - ABB Industries LLC

shortDescription: Abu Dhabi Aviation is the largest commercial helicopter and fixed-wing operator in the Middle East.
whatTheyDo: Abu Dhabi Aviation operates helicopter and fixed-wing aircraft fleets providing offshore oil and gas support, VIP charter, search and rescue, and aeromedical evacuation services across the UAE and internationally. The company also operates a specialized maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) facility at Al Bateen Executive Airport.
address: Next to Terminal 2, Al Bateen Executive Airport, P.O. Box 2723, Abu Dhabi, UAE
notes: Headquartered at Al Bateen Executive Airport (AZI) in Abu Dhabi, rather than Zayed International Airport (AUH).

shortDescription: Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank (ADCB) is a major UAE banking institution offering retail, corporate, and commercial financial services.
whatTheyDo: ADCB provides comprehensive banking services including consumer banking, corporate and investment banking, Islamic financial products, and wealth management. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, the bank operates across the UAE and maintains offshore banking hubs and international operations.
address: Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank Building, Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Street, P.O. Box 939, Abu Dhabi, UAE

sources.title: Sovereign Wealth Fund Institute - ADCB Profile

shortDescription: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB) is a leading Islamic financial institution headquartered in Abu Dhabi.
whatTheyDo: ADIB provides Sharia-compliant retail banking, corporate banking, private banking, treasury, and digital financing solutions. It serves individuals and corporate clients through an extensive branch network in the UAE alongside international operations in the Middle East and Europe.
address: Sheikh Rashid Bin Saeed Street (Old Airport Road), Al Muntazah, P.O. Box 313, Abu Dhabi, UAE

shortDescription: Accenture is a global professional services firm providing strategy, consulting, digital, and technology transformation services in the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Accenture delivers strategy and consulting, technology services, and managed operations across private enterprises and government entities in the UAE. Its Middle East practice leads digital transformation, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence programs from its headquarters in Dubai.
address: One Za'abeel Tower, Za'abeel Palace Street, Za'abeel First, Dubai, UAE
notes: Directory listed area as Dubai Internet City, but Accenture's official UAE office has relocated to One Za'abeel Tower, Za'abeel First, Dubai.

shortDescription: Accor is a multinational hospitality group managing and franchising a large portfolio of hotels and luxury resorts across the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Accor manages and franchises luxury, premium, midscale, and economy hotels and resorts across the UAE, including brands such as Raffles, Fairmont, Sofitel, Novotel, and Ibis. Its regional headquarters in Dubai Media City oversees hotel operations, brand marketing, and hospitality development across the Middle East, Africa, and Turkey.
address: GBS Building, Al Falak Street, Dubai Media City, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Hotelier Middle East - Accor Regional HQ

notes: Directory listed area as Downtown, but Accor's regional headquarters for the Middle East, Africa, and Turkey is located in the GBS Building, Dubai Media City.

shortDescription: Adecco Middle East provides workforce solutions, permanent recruitment, and temporary staffing services across the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Adecco delivers human resource solutions across the UAE, specializing in permanent recruitment, temporary staffing, executive search, and workforce outsourcing. The firm supports multiple sectors including technology, finance, engineering, and healthcare, and offers dedicated Emiratisation recruitment programs.
address: Office 2403, Citadel Tower, Business Bay, Dubai, UAE
notes: Adecco operates its Middle East regional headquarters at Marina Plaza, Dubai Marina, and maintains its Outsourcing and Delivery Services office at Citadel Tower, Business Bay, Dubai.
